checks.name: Canada Robotix is your source for Electronics, Raspberry Pi, Arduino

evidence-check.scope: Native HTML fields and dated explicit decisions. All 40 directory descriptions match the saved API; no new catalog specification is imported.

reimport-check.scope: Importer leaves every tracked data byte unchanged. Offline refresh may update only generation/comparison timestamps and the digest of timestamp-bearing coverage.

limitations: This batch checks 40 further saved listing URLs (rows 71-110); it does not establish completeness of the live competitor inventory. The source inventory remains dated November 1, 2026.
All 40 normalized detail descriptions match the saved raw API descriptions. This confirms source consistency, not independent truth of their claims.
All 40 decisions are recorded: 36 consistent with primary scope, 1 directory conflict, and 3 primary follow-ups required.

BuddyBot is listed as an interactive AI companion under XYZ Robotics with a MarketWatch link; XYZ Robotics is an industrial logistics robotics provider and does not make companion robots. Recorded as a directory attribution conflict.
BotEyes-Pad+ ($2499) and BotEyes-Pad++ ($2999) are commercial tablet/docking bundles of the base BotEyes-Pad robot ($1999) rather than separate robot chassis models.
Awabot Beam telepresence robot reflects historical Beam/BeamPro branding now renamed to Awabot One and Awabot Pro in the manufacturer lineup.
Carti Low-Profile represents Bear Robotics five-member under-cart AMR family (400, 600, 1000s, 1000, 1500 kg), mapped to those catalog models.

Three primary follow-ups remain open: Parrot CHUCK DV7 (unverified entertainment drone name vs autopilot module), Daifuku Cleaning Robot (unspecified cleaning offer), and GrabaRobot Cleaning Robot (broad sourcing category).
Directory descriptions and manufacturer claims do not establish exclusive USPs, independent performance, current availability, delivered deployments or market leadership.
Catalog CSVs, primary product highlights, specification reviews and existing identity decisions remain byte-identical. No front-end build or browser test is required for this batch.
